methods: read historical CPU contract results; no tests rerun

capabilities.implemented: Japan harness stores stage, originalMessage and stack in TASK_FAILURE.json; compile harness stores preparation stage in COMPILE_FAILURE.json. CPU worker stores phase/stage. GPU recorder stores current/last operation, frameIndex, firstFailure and separate cleanupFailure.
capabilities.evidence: Existing local COMPILE_FAILURE.json has CAMERA_AND_FULL_SOURCE_PREPARATION and UP2_PRIVATE_ROOT_ANCESTOR_UNSAFE.
capabilities.limit: Japan capture harness groups source preparation and capture into one coarse stage; GPU worker state alone can collapse to FAILED, requiring operation checkpoint.

capabilities.implemented: Local Japan failure preserves original message and stack; capture receipt stores a bounded error message. General failure formatter redacts log tails. GPU public export intentionally emits allowlisted codes/types/operation fields and safe runtime metadata.
capabilities.limit: Raw error text/stack is not guaranteed in public GPU exports; unknown errors remain UNCLASSIFIED_EXCEPTION. No claim of universal original-text retention.

capabilities.implemented: parsePrompt and presentation compiler classify INVALID, CONFLICT, UNSUPPORTED, NEEDS_INPUT with code/field/reason/example. Runtime guards reject schema, frame gaps/overlap, seals and unsupported family/scale.
capabilities.limit: Bounded grammar and attached facts only; not arbitrary natural language understanding or automatic fact retrieval. Japan script parses its input before its own try block, so malformed JSON at this entrypoint can bypass COMPILE_FAILURE.json.

capabilities.implemented: Source/catalog/asset SHA, native geometry binding, source/crop dimensions, CRS/coordinates, camera coverage and cache identities checked; missing/changed sources block with REGION_* or UP2_* codes.
capabilities.evidence: Japan source qualification hashes, HTTP_ASSET_BINDINGS, CAPTURE_RECEIPT and actual map images preserved.
capabilities.limit: These are integrity/admission checks, not historical truth certification.

capabilities.implemented: Capture emits per-frame progress, browser error list, error code, frame evidence, receipt, HTTP bindings and sums; worker records timeout, package/source, cleanup/progress and media-contract errors. Original Japan workflow preserves stdout/stderr and failure records.
capabilities.limit: Direct capture preflight/source preparation occurs before receipt try/finally; outer harness is necessary. Cleanup before receipt writes may prevent remaining writes if it throws; no new fault injection performed.

capabilities.implemented: Operation recorder covers WebGL/runtime/import/source preparation/draw/readback/PNG/encoder/progress/export/cleanup. Worker has atomic state, active checkpoint mirror, cleanup status and safe export. Runtime evidence includes safe browser diagnostics, native error codes, allocation and expected image identity.
capabilities.evidence: Historical actual incident7001b1f3 has frame179/renderedFrames180 checkpoint and safe diagnostic, with missingEvidence flags and UNKNOWN/UNCLASSIFIED values retained. Historical G1 record reports14 CPU-only cases, not GPU RCA validation.
capabilities.limit: Japan GPU run NOT_RUN; current production image not launched or tested. Storage mirror is best-effort, not proof of remote backup or recoverability after deletion.

capabilities.implemented: Exact known-code and bounded category mapping; unknown/error-evidence gaps remain explicit.
capabilities.evidence: Historical G1 has gpuRootCause=UNKNOWN, gpuExecuted=false, productionImageTested=false; actual historical GPU incident has missingEvidence and UNCLASSIFIED_EXCEPTION.
capabilities.limit: No validated automatic determination of every GPU driver/device/OOM/context crash root cause.

boundedFindings.observation: Original SHA256SUMS lists REQUEST.json and RUNTIME.json, but workflow copy allowlist did not archive them. REQUEST is byte-identical to committed RUNTIME_REQUEST.json; RUNTIME prepared snapshot is NOT_VERIFIED/not archived.
boundedFindings.minimumFutureImprovement: Add only prepared snapshot/receipt retention to a separately scoped future workflow change; preserve existing failure receipts. Do not rerun this successful render solely to fill the archive.

boundedFindings.observation: Japan compile input JSON.parse and CHECKPOINT read precede try; direct capture source preparation precedes capture receipt try. Malformed input or early setup may lack a structured receipt at these layers. Existing outer harness and logs cover some cases.
boundedFindings.minimumFutureImprovement: Wrap early input/preparation in existing structured failure path, preserving original error; add focused new failing-input case only if repair is separately undertaken.

boundedFindings.observation: software_worker.py maps child nonzero return to UP2_NATIVE_CAPTURE_FAILED and writes only stage/code/type; child original detail remains in separate logs/receipt if available.
boundedFindings.minimumFutureImprovement: Link existing bounded capture receipt error into worker failure record; retain redaction and no broad diagnosis rewrite.
